Title: JavaScript support for Durable Functions is now available

Body.Content:
Orchestrate your serverless workflows programmatically using the Durable Functions extension to the Azure Functions runtime, which will support JavaScript in general availability (GA) to be used for production workloads. Simplify complex, stateful coordination problems in serverless applications using Durable Functions, defining the workflows in code instead of using JSON schemas or any visual designer. With this release new scenarios are enabled for Node.js and JavaScript developers following some development patterns (such as functions chaining, fan-out/fan-in, or human interaction). 

Learn more
